items.where: the title's ARCADE card, under the word ARCADE: what an Arcade run is. Facts: one district; every few write-offs the grade rises, with a tougher chassis and denser traffic; the run ends when the shift's cars run out; the score is the points. Three lines of about 30 characters
items.text: One district, one shift of cars. Every few write-offs, you earn a tougher grade.

items.where: Arcade: the toast, and the write-off report's header, when the grade rises. A caps label; {G} is the new grade. Facts: the next chassis is tougher (more health); traffic is denser
